xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1.The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the applicable Indian Accounting Standards ('IndAS') as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act 2013, as amended, read with relevant rules thereunder and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, as amended. These Unaudited Standalone Financial Results, as reviewed by the Audit Committee of the Board, were approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on November 04, 2026.
2. Pursuant to the implementation of the four Labour Codes effective November 21, 2025, the Company assessed the consequential financial impact and recognised an amount of Rs 2.13 crores during the year ended March 31, 2026 as an exceptional item.
3. Subsequent to the approval by Board of Directors on May 21, 2026, the Company has exercised the contractual call option to acquire 20,864 equity shares in Earth Rhythm Limited (ERL) for consideration of Rs 9.43 crores during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
4. The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on August 04, 2026, approved the acquisition of 51% stake in Aminu Wellness Private Limited (‘AWPL’) for a consideration of up to Rs 32 crores. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of 51% stake in AWPL. The consideration paid during the current quarter towards this acquisition was Rs 21.70 crores, and the balance consideration is payable in accordance with the agreed schedule under the Share Subscription cum Purchase Agreement.
5. In accordance with Ind AS 108 ‘Operating Segments’, segment information has been given in the consolidated financial results of the Company and therefore, no separate disclosure on segment information is given in standalone financial results.
